description: nn-parity abi: tools/abi-compare.py (binutils readelf/nm) over our files at their FHS paths vs the 221 official RPMs, readelf/nm output passed through the path map (output store paths -> /usr). Target: 0 unexpected. Dynamic objects whose size changes only by a relocated path are classified by the tool (pathsized_dynsyms), not here. Rules name their effect: store-by-pieces (design §2.8), P2 (the locale-archive patch, §4.3).

allow.reason: the only dynamic-symbol difference of the relocated libc.so.6 is catopen's size (478 -> 606 bytes: its NLSPATH default with the store prefix is copied by inline vector stores, see tools/parity/nn-glibc-content.json); names, versions, types, bindings, visibility and every other size are equal (ours/official pin exactly this one changed line)

P2 (packages/glibc/nix-patches/locale-archive.patch, design §4.3): locale.c and locarchive.c read $LOCALE_ARCHIVE_2_27 / $LOCALE_ARCHIVE with secure_getenv, as nixpkgs: one new undefined dynamic symbol (ours/official pin exactly it)

P2 (packages/glibc/nix-patches/locale-archive.patch, design §4.3): the secure_getenv@GLIBC_2.17 reference adds a GLIBC_2.17 version need, so the .gnu.version table gains one entry and its version indices shift (the dynamic symbols themselves are compared by abi.dynsym)

P2 (packages/glibc/nix-patches/locale-archive.patch, design §4.3): loadarchive.o reads the two environment variables through glibc's internal hidden alias __libc_secure_getenv (an undefined reference resolved inside libc.a; ours/official pin exactly it)
